description: Source code for managing SPDY protocol connections, including connection establishment, stream management, frame handling, and shutdown procedures.

classes.name: idleAwareFramer
classes.description: A wrapper around spdy.Framer that manages idle timeouts and connection health.

classes.name: Connection
classes.description: Represents a SPDY connection, managing streams, frames, and connection lifecycle.

methods.name: NewConnection
methods.description: Creates a new SPDY connection from an existing network connection.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Sends a ping frame and measures response time.

methods.name: Serve
methods.description: Handles incoming frames and manages stream lifecycle.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Initiates connection shutdown by sending a GOAWAY frame.

methods.name: CloseWait
methods.description: Closes the connection and waits for shutdown to complete.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Waits for the connection to shutdown or timeout.

methods.name: NotifyClose
methods.description: Registers a channel to notify when the connection is closed.

methods.name: SetIdleTimeout
methods.description: Sets idle timeout for the connection.

methods.name: CreateStream
methods.description: Creates a new SPDY stream with specified headers.

methods.name: FindStream
methods.description: Finds a stream by ID, waiting if necessary.
